verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents behavioral cohorts: you can create them, and an API lists, exports and uploads them. Its analytics surface covers charts, funnels and user segmentation, which supports the slicing half of the story. No evidence item mentions retention analysis or retention-over-time charts, so the core measurement half is unevidenced. Missing for 10: explicit retention chart/analysis documentation, evidence that retention can be broken down by behavioral cohort, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can measure retention over time and slice it by behavioral cohorts

citations.quote: List all your cohorts in Amplitude, export a cohort in Amplitude, or upload a cohort.
Charts, dashboards, and insights. Build funnels, segment users, answer "why".
